C-SELF-CONTAINED-HTML-EXPORT.ApprovalBasis: Owner chat approval 2026-10-21 (translated from Russian: "ok") was given to the explicitly enumerated pipeline — spec approval, then this plan, then implementation — after the two-clean-passes review report; the plan adds no product decision beyond the approved spec.
C-SELF-CONTAINED-HTML-EXPORT.IntentSummary: Renderer-side embedding of local images into the styledHtml export: a new util resolves img src against the exporting document's directory, reads each distinct local image through ipcFs.readBinary (size-checked via ipcFs.stat against the 8 MiB cap), rewrites src to base64 data-URLs with extension-mapped MIME, accounts skipped references (remote/data/unknown-ext/missing/too-large/unresolvable), and the styledHtml branch of handleExport runs it before the save dialog write; a localized skipped-count notice lands in ten locales; pdf/print branches and their e2e stay untouched. Corners C-1..C-12 live in the sibling design-context CornerMatrix and are cited by task criteria.

T-001.Title: Util: exportImages.js — resolve (relative-to-doc-dir, POSIX absolute, Windows drive/extended-prefix via re-expressed correctImageSrc semantics with file:// strip, %20/unicode decode), stat-size gate (8 MiB), readBinary + base64 data-URL with extension-mapped MIME (png jpg jpeg gif webp bmp svg avif ico), dedup by resolved path, skipped accounting (remote/data/unknown-ext/missing/too-large/unresolvable-unc/untitled-no-dir), MODULE_CONTRACT + full unit matrix

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Corners C-1..C-4, C-6..C-11 green in the unit matrix; corners C-1 (relative PNG), C-2 (POSIX absolute), C-5 (remote untouched, no network), C-8 (≥8 MiB skipped without a read), C-10 (dedup single read) pinned by assertions; unknown extensions and generic UNC pass through uncounted-vs-counted exactly as the spec's R-1/R-4 split defines.

T-002.Title: Wire the pass into handleExport's styledHtml branch: embedLocalImages over the generated HTML with currentFile's directory before editorStore.EXPORT, skipped-count notice (warning type) only when skipped > 0, pdf/print branches untouched; arrayBufferToBase64 exported from fileSystem.js for reuse; editor.vue CHANGE_SUMMARY entry; component test pinning branch wiring + pdf/print non-invocation (corner C-12) + printService neighbor regression

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Component test proves: styledHtml export runs the pass with the document directory and surfaces the notice on skips; pdf and print flows never invoke embedLocalImages (corner C-12); untitled documents pass no directory and export without a notice (corner C-9); editor-print-clearup neighbor still green.

T-003.Title: Locales: editor.export.imagesEmbeddedTitle + editor.export.imagesEmbeddedMessage ({embedded}/{total}) as native copy in all ten static/locales/*.json (en framing: "Some images were not embedded" / "{embedded} of {total} images embedded — large or missing images keep their original links")

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All ten source locales carry both keys with the two placeholders present; wording is native copy per locale, not literal translation; en.json is the reference.

Verification.Command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ls=['de','en','es','fr','ja','ko','pt','ru','zh-CN','zh-TW'];for(const l of ls){const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('static/locales/'+l+'.json','utf8'));const e=j.editor&&j.editor.export;if(!e||!e.imagesEmbeddedTitle||!e.imagesEmbeddedMessage||!/\{embedded\}/.test(e.imagesEmbeddedMessage)||!/\{total\}/.test(e.imagesEmbeddedMessage))throw new Error(l)}console.log('ten locales OK')"

T-004.Title: e2e: tests/e2e/export-html-images.spec.ts — fixture document with one local PNG exports through the tauri-shim (plugin:dialog|save override capturing the path, mt_fs_write capturing content, mt_fs_read_binary feeding fixture bytes, mt_fs_stat feeding size) and the saved HTML's img src is a data:image/png;base64 URL decoding to the fixture bytes; remote-src image stays a URL in the same export

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Spec green on chromium: byte-identical embed assertion (spec AC-3), remote passthrough, and the print-export.spec.ts regression neighbor stays green in the same run.

T-005.Title: Graph + verification + hygiene: register M-065 (new util, features graph) and V-M-065 (export-images tests, features verification), add the embedding step to DF-007 (ExportHtmlOrPdf) in the flows graph, index entries if required by routing, contracts/CHANGE_SUMMARY present in every touched governed file

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: grace lint --path . reports 0 errors attributable to this bundle (pre-existing parallel-session errors in C-ACCEPTANCE-REGISTRY and release bundles are not this bundle's); M-065/V-M-065/DF-007 entries name the real files and commands.

Review.Findings: All five tasks executed. T-001: src/renderer/src/util/exportImages.js v1.0.0 (START_BLOCK_RESOLVE_SRC / START_BLOCK_EMBED_PASS) + 19-test unit matrix green. T-002: styledHtml branch wiring in editor.vue v1.31.0 (BLOCK_EMBED_IMAGES counts-only marker, MODULE_MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY updated), arrayBufferToBase64 exported from fileSystem.js v1.2.0, 6-test component pin + printService neighbor regression green (pdf/print never invoke the pass). T-003: imagesEmbeddedTitle/Message keys in all ten source locales + min mirrors. T-004: e2e byte-identity assertion green on chromium (local PNG embeds through mt_fs_stat + mt_fs_read_binary, never mt_fs_read; remote URL survives); print-export.spec.ts 3/3 green in the same run; dist rebuilt (preview server serves the built bundle — the pass is invisible until `npm run build`). T-005: M-065 + V-M-065 + graph/verification index entries and the DF-007 refresh landed; grace lint --assertions current = 0 errors. Two integration facts discovered and handled: (1) muya's export renders relative image src as absolute file:/// URLs — the pass resolves file URLs back to paths, so both spellings embed; the e2e fixture covers the file:/// form. (2) release-materials validates source/min locale mirrors with stable-JSON equality on every npm test run, so the ten .min.json mirrors must be regenerated in the same change — done; the 3 release-materials failures this caused mid-wave disappeared after regeneration. The single remaining npm-test failure (release-readiness.test.js:225, an unresolved merge-conflict marker) is the parallel session's in-flight file, untouched by this bundle. Known accepted gaps: no live macOS check yet (owner acceptance pending); the standalone-open-from-imageless-directory criterion is proven by the byte-identical data-URL assertion rather than by literally opening the file elsewhere.
